summary: CRITICAL: All three fixes claimed in the review request are ABSENT from the codebase. (1) backend/notion_service.py lookup_tracker_sn (lines 195-230) still uses the old title.equals filter with page_size=5 and returns results[0] — NO pagination, NO _parse_serials for multi-value cells. (2) backend/server.py submit_checklist (lines 420-475) has NO pre-persist re-check of serials against Tracker — it goes from availability check straight to create_pick. No 409-with-cliente/date code path exists. (3) frontend/src/pages/ChecklistPage.jsx handleScannedCode NOT_FOUND branch (lines 148-200) STILL contains the pending-fallback block that accepts arbitrary codes as SN when pendingSerializedItem is set. Live E2E reproduction: scanned SKU PPR2-0-2-4-K-002 (Pulsar Pro 22kw 5M) → 'PRODOTTO DISPONIBILE — Scansiona il seriale' (sets pending); then scanned arbitrary '9999999999' → banner 'Prodotto riconosciuto' and row 'Pulsar Pro 22kw 5M — SN 9999999999' was WRONGLY ADDED to the checklist (qty 1). This is the exact bug the request claimed to have fixed. Bogus code without pending shows 'PRODOTTO NON RICONOSCIUTO' + 'Codice non trovato in Notion. Se è un seriale, scansiona prima il codice del prodotto.' — NOT the expected red 'SERIALE NON TROVATO' with subtitle mentioning 'non risulta né tra le entrate'. Real SN 1427354 works (green SERIALE RICONOSCIUTO). Backend regression tests (test_receipts_lookup.py 4/4) still PASS.

critical.issue: Still uses title.equals filter + page_size=5 + results[0]. Will not detect SN in multi-value cells (e.g. '1384516, 1384517, 1384518'). Claimed rewrite (paginate + _parse_serials) NOT applied. Concurrency guard in submit_checklist will silently fail for multi-serial Tracker rows.
No pre-persist re-check of each serialized item's SNs against Tracker. Missing 409 response with cliente/date payload on concurrent conflict. Claimed guard not implemented.

ui_bugs.issue: Pending-fallback block (lines 148-200) still active. Any arbitrary code (e.g. '9999999999') is accepted as SN and added as a checklist row after a valid SKU scan. This is the exact regression the review request said was fixed.

Shows 'PRODOTTO NON RICONOSCIUTO' with subtitle 'Se è un seriale, scansiona prima il codice del prodotto.' — spec requires red 'SERIALE NON TROVATO' with subtitle mentioning 'non risulta né tra le entrate'.

action_items: RE-APPLY fix 1: rewrite backend/notion_service.py::lookup_tracker_sn to paginate the full Tracker DS (page_size=100, has_more/next_cursor loop) and match sn against _parse_serials(title) for each row. Return first hit including cliente/date/item_ids.

RE-APPLY fix 2: in backend/server.py::submit_checklist, BEFORE step 3 (create_pick loop), iterate every serialized item.serials and call notion_service.lookup_tracker_sn(s); if any hit → raise HTTPException(409, detail={code, cliente, date}).

RE-APPLY fix 3: in frontend/src/pages/ChecklistPage.jsx handleScannedCode, remove the entire pending-fallback branch inside `if (data.status === 'not_found')` (lines ~148-200). Replace with unconditional red banner: title 'SERIALE NON TROVATO', subtitle 'Il codice scansionato non risulta né tra le entrate né come SKU prodotto.' Do NOT add any row.
critical_code_review_comments: The developer's commit apparently did not persist to disk / was reverted / never made — three separate files all show the pre-fix code verbatim. Verify git status / hot-reload cache before re-implementing.

Live reproduction proves the pending-fallback bug: after scanning valid SKU PPR2-0-2-4-K-002, an arbitrary 10-digit '9999999999' was added as SN — confirming user's original bug report is 100% reproducible in current state.
Once fix 1 lands, the per-scan tracker lookup will become O(N) over full Tracker DS (same latency profile as receipts lookup, ~2-3s). Consider caching or asyncio.gather in inventory_lookup pipeline.
